verdict.rationale: The docs show ChatGPT supports installable third-party plugins that connect to work tools such as Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce and Gong. Workspace apps can be used in GPTs, and admins control plugin access. MCP servers offer a further way to add custom third-party tools, and a community post confirms plugin integrations in the core product. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browsable app/connector directory or catalog UI, a description of the install/auth flow for adding a connector, independent hands-on corroboration of browsing and adding apps.
